author: Warner Bros.
description: Writer/Director Paul Thomas Anderson and Cinematographer Michael Bauman crafted the “River of Hills” sequence through merging car-mounted VistaVision cameras and a ground-hugging perspective influenced by "The French Connection" to deliver a powerful sense of movement and scale. The sequence is seamlessly supported by the work of Composer Jonny Greenwood, Sound Mixer Tony Villaflor, and Supervising Sound Editor Christopher Scarabosio, whose music and sound design intensify the car chase tension and give you that roller coaster feel.
title: ONE BATTLE AFTER ANOTHER | "River of Hills" #shorts

author: Warner Bros.
description: Director Martin Scorsese reflects on the unparalleled vision and artistry of ONE BATTLE AFTER ANOTHER, written and directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, calling it “an epic American anthem” and its place within contemporary cinema as “a portrait of the country that hits the target exactly at the right moment.”
title: Director Martin Scorsese presents ONE BATTLE AFTER ANOTHER with Best Film at NBR Awards #shorts

author: Warner Bros.
description: Director/Writer/Producer Ryan Coogler envisioned SINNERS as a multidimensional narrative shaped by the enduring power of blues music. The film provides a bridge between generations while exploring themes of racial injustice, faith, and power. The New York Times praises SINNERS, writing that it “defies expectation at every turn, draws from different genres for a uniquely American story about race and resistance, art and community."
title: SINNERS | "Born With A Gift" #shorts
